children: Frankfurt am Main, September 25, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has today upgraded the long-term issuer rating and the senior unsecured ratings of LEG Immobilien SE to Baa1 from Baa2. We have also upgraded the senior unsecured MTN programme to Baa1 from Baa2, and changed the outlook to stable from positive. We have affirmed its P-2 short-term issuer rating and commercial paper rating.

title: Moody's Ratings upgrades LEG to Baa1; stable outlook
